```{r setup}
library(clinChat)
```

## Overview

`clinChat` lets you explore clinical datasets through natural language while keeping the data local.

## Example

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Sample clinical data
clinical_data <- data.frame(
  subject_id = paste0("S", 1:30),
  age = sample(25:75, 30, replace = TRUE),
  sex = sample(c("Male", "Female"), 30, replace = TRUE),
  treatment = sample(c("Drug A", "Placebo"), 30, replace = TRUE),
  response = sample(c("Yes", "No"), 30, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4))
)

# Create chat
chat <- create_clinical_chat(clinical_data)

# Ask questions (requires configured LLM provider)
# chat$chat("What is the response rate by treatment arm?")
```

## Launching the App

```{r, eval = FALSE}
run_clinchat_app(clinical_data, title = "My Clinical Study")
```

## Privacy

All data queries happen locally via tools. Only the results of those tools are passed to the language model.
